claim_text: Before anything is assumed, Someone is: the Trinity is the self-sufficient ground of all reality.
required_concession: This is a declared starting premise, not a conclusion.
support: Before there was time... there was love. A Father, a Son, and the Spirit between them—one being, three persons.

claim_text: The Trinity is one being, three persons: Father, Son, and Spirit are distinct centers of consciousness, love, and will.
required_concession: This is an axiom of the framework.
support: One being, three distinct centers of consciousness, love, and will—so united that to know one is to know all.

claim_text: The four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are assumed by every rival system but derived by none.
required_concession: This is a strong claim about all rival systems; not exhaustively proven.
support: Four assumptions. Each true. Each unable to pay for itself. Every rival ontology dies or collapses.

claim_text: The four debts are absolved in the Trinity: existence as aseity, distinction as persons, relation as perichoresis, orientation as love.
required_concession: This is a theological resolution, not a formal derivation.
support: We hold one axiom—God—and the four dissolve into Him.

claim_text: The Trinity is the structural minimum for truth to be fully real: truth requires being, expression, and witness.
required_concession: This is a conceptual argument, not a formal proof.
support: A solitary god could be powerful, but could not be truth in the full sense—because truth requires expression and witness.

claim_text: Truth is dimensionless and three-moded: Truth = (Being) × (Expression) × (Witness).
required_concession: This is an analogy, not a mathematical identity.
support: Truth is dimensionless in exactly this sense... It is a three-mode operator.

claim_text: The quaternion EM / Trinity isomorphism is Lean 4 verified with 478 theorems and zero sorry.
required_concession: This is a formal mathematical result, not a proof of the Trinity.
risks: Formal verification only covers the mathematical structure, not theological meaning.
support: Quaternion EM / Trinity isomorphism: Lean 4 verified, 478 theorems, zero sorry.

claim_text: Time is authored, not created: time is something the Trinity does, not a medium they inhabit.
required_concession: This is a theological claim about the nature of time.
risks: May conflict with some physics views.
support: Time is something the Trinity does, not a medium they inhabit.

claim_text: The nine fruits of the Spirit are the character of God Himself, existing eternally in the Trinity.
required_concession: This is a theological interpretation of Scripture.
support: The nine fruits of the Spirit are not a to-do list... They are the character of God Himself.

claim_text: The four debts are the price of admission to thinking at all; every rival system assumes them without payment.
required_concession: This is a strong claim about all rival systems.
support: The price of admission to thinking at all.

claim_text: The denial of orientation is an act of orientation; any critic who calls a claim false assumes the gradient.
required_concession: This is a self-referential argument; its force depends on the premise.
risks: Self-referential; may be seen as rhetorical.
support: Anyone who calls any claim false—including the critic who calls this framework false—has already assumed the gradient.

claim_text: The Trinity mapping is A1=Father (Existence), A2=Son (Distinction), A3=Spirit (Relation), A4=Truth (Orientation).
required_concession: This mapping is proposed, not fully verified.
risks: Mapping may be arbitrary; Version B needs check.
support: Trinity mapping: A1=Father (Existence), A2=Son (Distinction), A3=Spirit (Relation), A4=Truth (Orientation).

claim_text: T.4 (Omniscience) requires a formal bridge from coupling invariant to Shannon mutual information; this is open.
support: T.4 (Omniscience): Formal bridge from coupling invariant → Shannon mutual information needed.

claim_text: T.7 (Love as Ground State) is a proposed identification of inter-person coupling with Yukawa coupling; it is not yet confirmed as the same force.
required_concession: This is a proposed analogy, not a proven identity.
support: T.7 (Love as Ground State): Formal identification of inter-person coupling with Yukawa coupling—same form, but is it the SAME force or structural analogy?

claim_text: The n ≥ 4 bound in the Watcher is parsimony, not proof; never present all five instances as equally proven.
required_concession: This is a parsimony argument, not a proof.
support: n ≥ 4 bound in Watcher is parsimony, not proof.

claim_text: The derivative terms T.1–T.7 are newly derived (July 2026) and have NOT been through adversarial testing at the term level.
required_concession: This is an explicit admission of untested status.
support: The derivative terms T.1–T.7 are newly derived (July 2026) and have NOT been through adversarial testing at the term level.
